rev6.release_notes: Fusion Sync: the add-in's Scan opens G-SEND.IO on Fusion Sync; a progress bar on each design while it exports; press a tick box and drag to tick or untick many at once. The add-in's Speeds & Feeds is locked until a key is entered (Settings > Key). Settings > API Keys: OpenAI, Anthropic and GROK link to where you make a key. Calculator: Tab jumps to the next calculator. Shared simulations are lit like Simulate (gold inserts, steel holders).

cadcam.release_notes: Simulate now moves like G-SEND.IO's while simulating: pan with middle or Ctrl drag, turn with Shift or right drag, the wheel zooms about the middle, the same view cube. Help → Check for Updates. Shared simulations move the same way and carry the G-SEND.IO wordmark.
